dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Greetings, Miss Iratxa. And how are the fruits of your investigation today?

dialogues.speaker: Iratxa
dialogues.text: Oh my, Lady Nefer, what an unexpected pleasure. Well, my dear "friend" is hiding somewhere in town, I'm sure of it. Just a bit more, and I'll be certain to flush him out.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: How diligent of you. Still, should the task prove... troublesome, the Curatorium of Secrets would be more than glad to lend its aid.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: After all, Mr. Lestocq frequently supplies us with the most invaluable sc{RUBY#[D]intel}rews. And as for vis{RUBY#[S]Marechaussee Phantom agents}itors from Fontaine, we are, of course, always glad to be of service.

dialogues.speaker: Iratxa
dialogues.text: Your generosity is most appreciated. Alas, this is strictly a personal matter between "friends." I couldn't possibly dream of troubling st{RUBY#[D]outsiders}rangers over this.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I understand. I hope you find your "friend" soon.
